create.title: Share a secret securely
create.lead: Password, API key, private message… The generated link can be opened only once, then the secret is destroyed.
create.secretPlaceholder: Paste the content to share here…
create.passphraseHint: Send it through a different channel than the link.

created.instructions: Send this link to your recipient. It will work only once.
created.protected: Protected by a passphrase: the recipient will need to enter it.
created.notice: The content is not shown here: only you have seen this secret, and the link is the only way to access it.

open.warning: This secret can be read only once. Once shown, it will be permanently destroyed: make sure to copy it.
open.protectedNotice: This secret is protected by a passphrase.
open.destroyedNotice: This secret has just been deleted from the server. If you close this page, it will be lost.

wrongPassphrase.one: Incorrect passphrase. You have {count} attempt left.
wrongPassphrase.other: Incorrect passphrase. You have {count} attempts left.

unavailable.title: Secret unavailable
unavailable.text: This link doesn't exist, has expired or has already been opened. Check that the link is complete; if you didn't open it yourself, let the sender know.

destroyed.title: Secret destroyed
destroyed.text: Too many incorrect attempts: this secret has been permanently destroyed. Let the sender know.

errors.network: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.server: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errors.invalidRequest: The request is invalid. Please check the form.

field.secretText: Enter a secret of up to 10,000 characters.
field.ttlSeconds: Choose an expiration between 1 minute and 7 days.
field.passphraseMissing: Enter a passphrase or untick the protection.
